I am happy to announce that I have started to work on a new map of Mother Ghoul: The Cursed Girl's Farm.

Step into the shadows with the latest map in "Mother Ghoul," titled "The Cursed Girl’s Farm." This eerie setting revolves around a haunted farmstead, where the spirit of a tormented girl, locked and tortured in the basement for years, still lingers. As players navigate through the farm's hidden passages and dark recesses, they'll not only face physical threats but also confront the spectral remnants of a chilling past.

The farm is shrouded in mystery, with echoes of horrific events resounding through its dilapidated structures. Every corner and shadow holds secrets of the farm’s sinister history, waiting to be uncovered. The environment challenges players to use both wit and strategy to discover ancient artifacts and solve the puzzles hidden within the haunted grounds.

As you evade the malevolent spirit of the cursed girl, your journey will reveal the dark narratives buried beneath the farm, compelling you to piece together the fragments of a forgotten tragedy. With new enemies, intriguing puzzles, and intense gameplay, "The Cursed Girl’s Farm" promises to be the most terrifying addition to the "Mother Ghoul" series yet.

Dare to open the doors to this haunted farm, but remember, every step takes you deeper into the shadows of the past.

Stay tuned guys!

notes.title: Power of Holy Water! %66 BIG DISCOUNT 😱
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062495/7d42f7d3b6a33503ba8b3590b97bdd43b4a42c93.png[/img]

Holy water has a storied history in many cultures, revered for its purported purifying and protective properties. In the game "Mother Ghoul," this mystical liquid becomes your primary defense against a menacing witch that haunts the ancient, gothic church where the game is set. According to lore, holy water can ward off evil due to its blessed nature. This is why players can use it to combat the dark forces at play, effectively turning a simple substance into a powerful weapon against supernatural threats.

In "Mother Ghoul," players find themselves navigating the eerie corridors of a dilapidated church. The witch, a once-guardian of the sacred place, now roams its halls with malevolent intent. Her presence is a corruption of the sanctuary, and it's up to the player to restore peace. To do this, players must strategically use holy water found within the church. The central fountain, a masterpiece of medieval architecture, serves as a refill station where players can replenish their holy water supplies during the intense gameplay.

The game mechanics are designed to emphasize strategy and timing. Players must aim and throw the holy water accurately to weaken the witch. Each splash of holy water burns the witch, reducing her power and ultimately leading to her purification or destruction. As players progress, they unlock more about the witch's backstory and the history of the holy water, deepening the narrative and engagement.

Join us this week for an incredible [b]66% discount [/b]during our major promotional event! Don't miss your chance to dive into the dark yet intriguing world of "Mother Ghoul" at a fraction of the price. Whether you're battling evil or unraveling ancient mysteries, "Mother Ghoul" promises a thrilling adventure steeped in rich lore and challenging gameplay.

notes.title: Passed 1000+ Wishlists! Mother Ghoul will protect her Unborns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062495/9ecc097f7f32d4707686998983dc3c6218bf96ff.jpg[/img]

I am absolutely thrilled to announce that Mother Ghoul, our spine-tingling horror game, has now surpassed 1000 wishlists on Steam! This is a momentous milestone for us, and we couldn't have done it without your incredible support and enthusiasm.

Mother Ghoul is more than just a game; it's a heart-pounding journey into the depths of fear and the unknown. Set in a dark and mysterious world, you'll find yourself immersed in an eerie storyline filled with chilling encounters, mind-bending puzzles, and a sense of dread that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Key Features of Mother Ghoul:

A Gripping Story: Uncover the secrets of a haunted mansion as you navigate through a narrative filled with twists and turns.
Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in a chilling atmosphere with stunning visuals and haunting soundscapes.
Mind-Bending Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles to progress, all while under the constant threat of supernatural entities.
Unpredictable Encounters: Face terrifying and unpredictable foes that will test your courage and wit.
We want to extend our sincerest thanks to each and every one of you who added Mother Ghoul to your wishlist, shared the game with friends, or offered feedback during its development. Your support has been invaluable to us.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to work tirelessly to bring you the most bone-chilling and unforgettable gaming experience possible. Together, we will dive deeper into the darkness, confront our fears, and unearth the secrets hidden within Mother Ghoul.

Thank you for being a part of this journey, and we can't wait to share more with you in the near future.

Sincerely,

Queen Developer <3

notes.title: Demo is Released! Mother Ghoul is waiting for you!
notes.content:
Mother Ghoul: A Solo-Developed Horror Game That Will Haunt Your Dreams!

Attention, fellow horror enthusiasts! I am thrilled to announce the spine-chilling debut of "Mother Ghoul," a bone-chilling game that I have single-handedly crafted for all you brave souls out there. Prepare yourselves for an immersive journey that will send shivers down your spine and leave you yearning for more.

In "Mother Ghoul," you will assume the role of a lone protagonist—the fruit of my creative vision—who finds themselves thrown into a forsaken graveyard after a brutal blow to the head. As you regain consciousness, the horrifying truth unfolds before your eyes: you have become the unwilling prey of the merciless Mother Ghoul. Your mission? Escape the clutches of this malevolent entity and find a way to survive in this nightmarish realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062495/cf8050faa8dccb2c98bb565c3b311d0d5b0bf475.jpg[/img]

The demo version I present to you today offers a tantalizing glimpse into this dark and treacherous world. Embark on a harrowing adventure through shadowy corridors, encounter bone-chilling surprises, and unlock perplexing puzzles that will test your intellect. Immerse yourself in a narrative that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you fight for your very survival.

Prepare to be captivated by the eerie visuals I have painstakingly crafted for "Mother Ghoul." With intricate details, atmospheric lighting, and hauntingly realistic environments, every pixel breathes life into the palpable dread that surrounds you. Through meticulously designed cinematics and spine-tingling sound effects, I aim to deliver an experience that will leave an indelible mark on your psyche.

I value your feedback immensely as the sole creator of this bone-chilling masterpiece. Together, we can shape the final release of "Mother Ghoul" and create an even more unforgettable gaming experience. Your insights, suggestions, and fearsome encounters will guide me on this treacherous journey as I strive to exceed your darkest expectations.

Without further ado, I invite you to immerse yourself in the world of "Mother Ghoul" through its captivating demo version. Brace yourself for a solo-developed adventure that will push the boundaries of your courage. Survive the horrors that await, for you are the sole protagonist of this terror-filled odyssey.

Stay tuned for future updates as I continue to pour my heart and soul into the full release of "Mother Ghoul." Together, let us defy the darkness and conquer our deepest fears.
